resources.name: Detect Thoughts
resources.description: One free daily use; an unused spell slot of 1st level or higher can supply additional uses.

resources.name: Telepathic Bond
resources.description: One free daily use; an unused spell slot of 4th level or higher can supply additional uses.

choice_providers.label: Remade Self
choice_providers.description: Choose the permanent spell-like effect gained at 20th level. The choice cannot normally be changed.

power_providers.label: Phrenic Amplifications
power_providers.description: Choose one amplification at 1st, 3rd, and every 4 levels thereafter. Major amplifications become eligible at 11th level.

notes: Psychic discipline, discipline spells and powers, phrenic pool ability, amplifications, and spell-slot alternatives remain separate systems.
